notes: The text's 'will be a king' is rendered as rise to authority, leadership and public standing. Only the yogas computable from the birth chart are encoded.

skipped.reason: Use Jaimini factors (Atmakaraka, Karakamsa, Arudha/Pada, Hora and Ghatika lagnas) that the engine does not compute yet.
'6th, 8th and 3rd occupied by debilitated planets' needs a per-occupant dignity test.
Birth within 2.5 ghatis of midday or midnight: needs local apparent time.
Vargottama Moon/ascendant aspected by four or more planets: needs an aspect-count predicate.

rules.text: Benefics in the 1st, 2nd and 4th with a malefic in the 3rd: rise to a position of command, or a life on that level.
An exalted benefic (Moon, Jupiter, Venus or Mercury) in the 2nd house: the person will be wealthy.

The lords of the 6th, 8th and 12th are debilitated, combust or in enemy signs while the ascendant lord, exalted or in its own sign, aspects the ascendant: a raja yoga, lifting the person to authority.
The 10th lord, in its own or exalted sign, aspects the ascendant — or all the benefics are in angles: a raja yoga, lifting the person to authority.

The 5th and 9th lords (the 'chief minister' and 'minister' of the chart) are conjunct or in mutual aspect: the person is entitled to lead, and one born into an established family certainly rises to head it.
The 4th and 10th lords exchange houses and receive the aspect of the 5th or 9th lord: a share in power and governance.
The lords of the 1st, 4th, 5th and 10th are all together with the 9th lord: rise to the top, with fame that spreads widely.
The 4th or 10th lord is conjunct the 5th or 9th lord: a share in power and authority.
The 5th lord, joined by the 9th lord or the ascendant lord, sits in the 1st, 4th or 10th house: rise to a position of command.
Jupiter in the 9th house — in its own sign with Venus, or joined by the 5th lord: rise to a position of command.
The Moon and Venus aspect each other (classically from the 3rd and 11th houses): a raja yoga.
Two or three planets are exalted: someone born to position attains it, and someone born without it rises to a comparable level.
rules.note: The verse says 'even fewer than three'; encoded conservatively as two or three so a single exalted planet does not trigger it.

rules.text: Four or more planets are exalted or in moolatrikona: even from humble beginnings the person rises to the highest rank.
One of Jupiter, Venus or Mercury is exalted while the other benefics are in angles: rise to a position of command.
rules.note: 'The other benefics in angles' is encoded as at least two benefics in angles.

rules.text: All benefics in angles and all malefics in the 3rd, 6th and 11th: even from humble beginnings the person rises to the highest rank.
